churchName.value: Sample Baptist Church — fictional learning example

identity.value: Independent Fundamental Baptist; example configuration derived from the project that inspired this toolkit.

currentAuthority.value: Example: existing church officers continue under their current governing authority. Confirm each responsibility before transfer.

pulpitPlan.value: Example preparation: the serving pastor covers scheduled services; designated leaders arrange authorized supply when needed.

immediateMessage.value: Example: an authorized leadership update explains the planned transition and the next meeting.

operations.value: Example: treasurer and existing officers maintain ordinary operations under current controls.

recordsAccess.value: Example: assign a secure inventory and access handoff; no credentials belong in this workbook.

carePlan.value: Example: designate a care coordinator and provide confidential support through existing church channels.

nextMeeting.value: Example: leadership will agree on the committee formation agenda; date not yet confirmed.

documents.value: Example derived from source church constitution/bylaws and adopted process. Obtain your own current authoritative documents.

createAuthority.value: Source-derived example: the church forms the pulpit committee under its governing provisions.

selectMembers.value: Source-derived example: deacons select additional eligible voting members.

approveMembers.value: Source-derived example: committee approval requires at least two-thirds of members present; verify notice and quorum separately.

composition.value: Source-derived example: all deacons plus at least two additional voting members; additional members do not exceed the number of deacons.

committeeAuthority.value: Example: research and recommend within the authority actually granted; the committee does not call the pastor.

chairRule.value: Source-derived operating choice: a deacon chairs. This is not presented as a universal constitutional rule.

chair.value: Example: chair selected through the approved process; no real person identified.

conflicts.value: Example: disclose interests, record recusal, restrict access, and use independent oversight when an internal person may be considered.

callAuthority.value: Source-derived example: the congregation makes the final call.

voteThreshold.value: Source-derived example: two-thirds of eligible members present. Verify the complete governing provision and denominator.

preachRule.value: Source-derived example: the candidate preaches before the call decision.

meetingRule.value: Source-derived example: recommendation precedes the following midweek worship service business meeting. Confirm eligibility, quorum, and notice from current documents.

responsibilities.value: Example draft: preaching, teaching, care, evangelism, discipleship, and equipping members; workload to be agreed.

staff.value: Example: volunteer ministry leaders and deacons share practical work.

strengths.value: Example: faithful service, personal relationships, and community connections.

challenges.value: Example: limited volunteer capacity; clarify realistic expectations before presenting the position.

updateRhythm.value: Example: authorized process updates at regular church gatherings.

questionChannel.value: Example: questions and suggestions go to the designated committee contact; contact details remain to be confirmed.
